title: format_int_list() drops a range at the end of the list
body:
`format_int_list` in `boltons/strutils.py` loses the last values when
the list ends with a contiguous range:

```python
>>> format_int_list([1, 5, 6, 7])
'1'      # expected '1,5-7'
>>> format_int_list([2, 3])
''       # expected '2-3'
```

Expected: every value is represented, a trailing contiguous run is
written as "min-max" with the given `range_delim`, and
`parse_int_list(format_int_list(xs)) == sorted(set(xs))`.
provenance: upstream code at a pinned commit with an injected regression; the oracle is the unmodified upstream file

source.modifications: reformatted with black (layout and quote style only) to pass the repository formatting check; snapshot adds the injected defect, visible tests and empty package markers

defect: The final contiguous range is never flushed to the output.
